payload.recallText: I was a reporter in the Bronx for a school newspaper called the Fordham.  I wanted to do a story on how our dean of students was trying to push out lower class students by raising the tuition next year above the inflation rate.  The dean, who's name escapes me, was hard headed but I did catch up with him and asked him if this was his plan.  Before he could answer I saw out of the corner of my eye a blur and then the dean was struck in the face with a cream pie.  I gave the dean a few seconds then asked him if he had a comment of the recent attack and his response was "Fuck You".  I knew this was a great story so I ran back to the office and told my editor what had happened.  He said the dean was a dick and go ahead and run with it.  I started writing this story and then I did what many reporters do, I embelished it.  This is frowned upon but everyone does it.  I called the mystery man "The Pie Man" who wore a cape, just like a superhero.  I showed the story to my editor and he loved it and said it was going on the first page.  A few days later I got a message from someone that said if I liked that with the dean to meet them by the library on a certain day and time and they would see something again, signed "The Pie Man" I was there and the waiting when the student body president came out.  She was dressed in a flannel shirt and jean, just the type the dean wanted as students.  The "Pie Man" struck again!  I was at a bar and a girl came up to me and asked how I knew where the "Pie Man" was going to strike all the time and asked if I was him.  I knew if I said yes she would have sex with me.
